script_text: Pisces, the cosmos is forcing a major reckoning this week and you won't be the same. The shift arrives Thursday as Venus enters your 7th House forming a trine to Jupiter opening genuine love and partnership opportunities. Weekend Moon sextile to Neptune in your 4th House brings emotional calm especially Sunday while career finances settle. Friday is your power day because Venus trines Jupiter in your 7th House radiating love energy. Monday is your worst day, Saturn's square from the 2nd House strains finances. Honor your water element and let Jupiter in your 1st House guide bold not fear. Follow for daily updates.
